games.materials: Three cups and one paper ball
games.setup: Place three cups in a row and secretly put a paper ball under one cup.
games.turn: The lead gives one truthful clue about the position, and a partner points to a cup.
games.success: The selected cup contains the paper ball.
games.format: Form two teams. Each team has four turns; only the lead’s teammates respond or assist. Each success earns the team one point. The higher team score wins; ties are shared.
